title: Ascendancy Points and Trials: How to Get All 8
summary: How Path of Exile 2 Ascendancy works: the two trials (Sekhemas and Chaos), the 8-point ladder, where every key drops, and how to recover a failed endgame run.
description: A complete reference for earning all 8 Ascendancy Points in Path of Exile 2 through the Trial of the Sekhemas and the Trial of Chaos.
prerequisites: A character that has reached Act 2 (for the first trial)
Basic understanding of your build's defenses and damage
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

items.title: How many points and how?
body: You can earn a maximum of 8 Ascendancy Points, granted in four pairs of 2. Each pair comes from completing one of the two Trials of Ascendancy. Either trial alone can grant all 8 points - you are not forced to do both.

items.title: Which trial first?
body: The Trial of Sekhemas unlocks in Act 2 after defeating Balbala in Traitor's Passage. The Trial of Chaos unlocks in Act 3 after defeating Xyclucian in the Chimeral Wetlands. Pick whichever you reach first; many players find Chaos smoother for the early points.

items.title: What changes after Act 3?
body: Points 5-6 need a level 60+ Djinn Barya (Sekhemas, 3 floors) or a 10-room Inscribed Ultimatum (Chaos). Points 7-8 need a level 75+ Djinn Barya with 4 floors plus Zarokh, or a 10-room Ultimatum plus three Fate fragments and the Trialmaster.

sections.title: Sekhemas vs Chaos
sections.intro: The two trials share the same reward ladder but play nothing alike. Choose based on your build's strengths.

tabs.label: Trial of Sekhemas
paragraphs: A Sanctum-style gauntlet built around a separate Honour bar that drains whenever you take damage.
bullets: Unlocked in Act 2: defeat Balbala, the Traitor in Traitor's Passage to get Balbala's Barya (a quest item with unlimited retries).
Honour is a second health bar; if it hits 0 you fail even at full life. Manage Honour, not your life pool.
Rooms include trap gauntlets, blood chalices, death crystals, mirror trials, and hourglass survival waves.
Relics (chosen before the run) add buffs; prioritise Honour Resistance, Maximum Honour, and movement speed.
Final bosses scale by floor: Rattlecage (floor 1) up to Zarokh, the Temporal (floor 4 on a 75+ Barya).
Best for high-mobility, evasion, and ranged builds that avoid hits.

tabs.label: Trial of Chaos
paragraphs: An Ultimatum-style gauntlet fought with your normal health bar, but every room stacks a permanent affliction.
bullets: Unlocked in Act 3: kill Xyclucian, the Chimera in the Chimeral Wetlands for the Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum.
Each room is a wave fight; after clearing you choose 1 of 3 afflictions (a permanent debuff) before the next room.
4 rooms grant points 1-2 (boss Scourge of the Skies); 7 rooms grant 3-4; 10 rooms grant 5-6.
Points 7-8 require a 10-room Ultimatum plus three Fate fragments (Cowardly, Deadly, Victorious) to face the Trialmaster.
Common rewards: Vaal Orbs, Soul Cores, corrupted gear, and Trialmaster chase uniques.
Best for tanky, high-area-of-effect builds that can out-sustain afflictions.

sections.title: The 8-point ladder
sections.caption: Either trial alone can provide all 8 points. The right column shows the requirement for that point pair in each trial.

cells.sekhemas: Defeat Balbala, use Barya, clear floor (Rattlecage)
cells.chaos: Defeat Xyclucian, use Ultimatum, clear 4 rooms (Scourge of the Skies)

cells.sekhemas: Djinn Barya, 4 floors + defeat Zarokh, the Temporal
cells.chaos: Inscribed Ultimatum, 10 rooms + 3 Fate fragments + defeat the Trialmaster

sections.note: Campaign Barya and Ultimatum are quest items and can be retried infinitely. Endgame Djinn Baryas and Inscribed Ultimatums are tradeable but consumed on use - failing an endgame run destroys the key.

sections.title: Where every key drops
sections.intro: Each trial is opened by a specific item. Here is where to get every version.

cards.title: Balbala's Barya
body: Drops from Balbala, the Traitor in Traitor's Passage. A quest item, so it never disappears and can be retried until you ascend.

cards.title: Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum
body: Drops from Xyclucian, the Chimera in the Chimeral Wetlands. Also a quest item with unlimited retries.

cards.title: Djinn Barya (level 60+ / 75+)
body: Found in level 60+ (3 floors) and 75+ (4 floors) zones. Tradeable, but consumed on use - a failed run loses the key.

cards.title: Inscribed Ultimatum (10 rooms)
body: Found in level 75+ zones. Tradeable and consumed on use. Reaching 10 rooms unlocks points 5-6 and the Trialmaster path.

cards.title: Fate fragments
body: Cowardly Fate (Uxmal, the Beastlord), Deadly Fate (Bahlak, the Sky Seer), Victorious Fate (Chetza, the Feathered Plague). Hold all three to challenge the Trialmaster for points 7-8.

sections.title: Stuck on a trial?
sections.intro: Select your trial and the problem you are hitting. The tool gives the fix.

rules.title: Stack Honour Resistance and Maximum Honour
steps: Aim for the 75% Honour Resistance cap via relics; each hit then loses far less Honour.
Pick movement-speed and Maximum Honour relics, and choose rooms that restore Honour over ones that grant keys.
Avoid optional fights - in Sekhemas, evasion beats killing.

rules.title: Get the campaign key from the act boss
steps: You must defeat Balbala, the Traitor in Act 2 Traitor's Passage for Balbala's Barya.
If you are in Cruel and skipped her, the Watchful Twins in Deshar can drop a Sekhemas entry.

rules.title: Overlevel and prep before the boss
steps: The Trialmaster at 10 rooms is endgame内容; overlevel to at least the key's area level before attempting.
For Sekhemas bosses, reach roughly 400+ Honour before the final fight.

rules.title: Pick afflictions that do not brick your build
steps: Avoid No Regeneration, Monster Speed, and Reduced Player Damage on the same run.
Choose afflictions your build can ignore (e.g. a build that does not rely on a specific flask).
If a run is cursed with bad afflictions, cash out early rather than pushing to the boss.

defaultResult.title: General recovery plan
steps: Campaign keys (Balbala's Barya, Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum) are quest items - retry as many times as you need.
For endgame keys, farm a replacement from level-appropriate zones or trade for one rather than forcing a doomed run.
Overlevel by a few levels above the key's area level; the difficulty spike between campaign and endgame trials is large.

items.question: Do I have to do both trials?
answer: No. Either the Trial of Sekhemas or the Trial of Chaos can grant all 8 points on its own. Most players specialise in the one their build handles better.

items.question: What happens if I fail an endgame trial?
answer: Endgame Djinn Baryas and Inscribed Ultimatums are consumed on use, so a failed run destroys the key. You must farm or trade for another. Campaign quest keys are safe to retry forever.

items.question: Is there an Honour resistance cap?
answer: Yes - 75%, mirroring the normal resistance cap. Reaching it dramatically improves Sekhemas survivability.

items.question: Which trial is easier for the first 4 points?
answer: Many players report the Trial of Chaos as smoother for points 3-4 because it uses your normal health bar. Sekhemas favours mobile, hit-avoiding builds.
